bio: On the square of a charming village, this dry-stone building has everything you could wish for, from a shaded terrace to a bistro-style interior. To top it all off, the Provençal fare is full of flavour. For instance, the courgette flower stuffed with Brousse cheese and basil, Mediterranean meagre, rockfish stock with saffron and tarte Tatin with apricots from Provence go down a treat!...
